chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: The Cotton Club and Nierenberg's grandfather
summary: Nierenberg mentions his grandfather George Goodrich was the Cotton Club's accountant, and Bubbles says Buck and Bubbles were outstanding acts there.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Mh-hm. Talking about the Cotton Club times, too.
You know that my grandfather was an accountant --
Yeah? How about that -- good old times (inaudible).
He knew all of them, I'm sure he knew you.

Yeah, he had to know us because we were one of the outstanding acts -- once upon a time. They got what's- her name there, there even -- Lena Horne, she wasn't ever there, not to my knowledge. She come by there when everything was over.
